notablePrerequisites: There are at least three counters on Kinsbaile Borderguard.
description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Kinsbaile Borderguard, adding {C}{C}.
When Kinsbaile Borderguard dies, its last ability triggers, creating three Kithkin Soldier tokens that each enter with a vigilance counter due to Tayam.
Activate Tayam by paying {3} and removing three vigilance counters from creatures you control, milling yourself three cards and returning Kinsbaile Borderguard from your graveyard to the battlefield. Kinsbaile Borderguard enters with a vigilance counter due to Tayam and at least three +1/+1 counters due to its first ability.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing a Kithkin Soldier and Kinsbaile Borderguard, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When Kinsbaile Borderguard dies, its last ability triggers, creating four Kithkin Soldier tokens that each enter with a vigilance counter due to Tayam.
Repeat from step 3 any number of times, increasing the number of +1/+1 counters and tokens each time.
